_comment: Regauntless BACKGROUNDS — the third character-creation grant source (Race/Class/Background; see character-creation.md). HOUSE-AUTHORED content: NOT transcribed from any SRD (there is no backgrounds system in SRD 3.5; 5e's are mostly closed WotC content). These use familiar archetype TROPES (pirate, soldier, medic, cultist) as inspiration but the MECHANICS and wording are our own, built on our own primitives (skills.json / feats.json / the +-5 circumstance pile in combat.md). Keeps the project license-clean (OGL 3.5 + original house content, no closed 5e material). A background grants: grantedFeats (perks AND drawbacks — disadvantages = negative feats), skillsMadeNative (reclassify a skill to class-skill/1pt-per-rank + a starting rank), and flavor. Backgrounds are USUALLY perk+drawback (teeth), but may be pure-upside (Medical). The 'Backgrounds pattern' (seed rank + reclassify-to-native) is reusable for any skill.

_schema.name: string
_schema.grantedFeats: [{feat: key -> feats.json, kind: perk|drawback, houseAuthored: bool, effect: short plain-language effect}]
_schema.skillsMadeNative: [{skill: key -> skills.json, startingRank: int, note}] — reclassify to native (1pt/rank) for this char + seed rank (character-creation.md Backgrounds pattern)

backgrounds.name: Pirate
backgrounds.flavor: A sea-raider's life: quick to grab loot, lousy at polite company. (The one Grukk the Half-Orc Fighter runs.)

grantedFeats.effect: -5 circumstance (the 3.5 'disadvantage' = flat -5, combat.md) on social interactions.

skillsMadeNative.note: rigging & rope — Climb becomes class-native (1pt/rank) + start at 1
sea legs — Swim native + start at 1

backgrounds.note: Perk+drawback package with teeth: loot bonus bought with social penalty. Greedy/Unsavory are house feats (need entries in feats.json when the feat-authoring pass happens). Social -5 lives in the circumstance pile (only bites IF a social-check context exists; combat.md).

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.flavor: Drilled in a real army — disciplined, hard to rattle, knows one weapon cold. The professional.

grantedFeats.effect: SRD feat (feats.json). Granted with a chosen weapon (choice set at creation) — the drilled-in weapon. +1 attack (reinterpret per combat.md).
+5 circumstance to resist FEAR / morale-break effects (discipline under fire).

skillsMadeNative.note: command presence — Intimidate native + start at 1

backgrounds.note: Pure-ish upside (a professional's competence), balanced by spending a background pick rather than a drawback. Weapon Focus is SRD; Steady is a house feat (fear-resist +5). No drawback — not every background needs one (character-creation.md: usually paired, not required).

backgrounds.name: Medical
backgrounds.flavor: Battlefield surgeon / field medic before the Gauntlet. The one who can patch you up.

skillsMadeNative.note: THE medic enabler (character-creation.md / combat-model.md revive): Heal becomes class-native (1pt/rank, not cross-class 2x) + start at 1 -> the First-Aid revive button lights up from level 1.

backgrounds.note: The canonical pure-upside background (character-creation.md example). Its whole value = cheap Heal scaling + a starting rank, making ANY class a viable field medic. No drawback. This is what makes 'who's the medic' a build choice.

backgrounds.name: Raised in a Cult
backgrounds.flavor: Grew up in a fervent sect — picked up real liturgy and a little genuine divine power, plus some baggage. (The honest-named version of the sanitized 'acolyte'.)

grantedFeats.effect: Grants divine casting at the DABBLER envelope (character-creation.md: a reduced caster progression, ~half slots / low caster level / capped tier) — NOT full cleric casting. Proof a background can grant a class feature.
-5 circumstance on WILL saves vs effects that play on faith/fear/charm-of-conviction (true-believer blind spot). (Tunable; placeholder drawback.)

skillsMadeNative.note: liturgical focus — Concentration native + start at 1 (helps the dabbler casting)

backgrounds.note: The 'capability from a non-class source' proof case (character-creation.md: Warrior-raised-in-a-cult can cast). Divine Casting is a house-granted feat carrying the DABBLER caster envelope (defer the actual progression numbers to the caster layer). Perk+drawback: power bought with a will-save blind spot. Skips a separate 'Acolyte' background — this IS that trope, better-named.
